CustomField.description: Internal field used to calculate setup price for IWX. To be deprecated if not in use.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( SBQQ__ProductCode__c = 'IWXBundleW2',SBQQ__ProductCode__c = 'IWXBundle',SBQQ__ProductCode__c = 'IWXContractors') , IF( SBQQ__Quantity__c <= NSP_Max_Quantity__c , NSP_Final_Minimum_Fee__c , SBQQ__PackageTotal__c ) , 0)
CustomField.label: WX Setup Fee Contribution
